# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release of lantern.wz receives security fixes. Update to it
before reporting.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities privately through the
[private report form](https://github.com/sravioli/lantern.wz/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue or pull request for a vulnerability.

Include the lantern.wz version or commit, your WezTerm version, and the
smallest configuration that shows the problem. Examples of what counts: running
unintended commands, reading or writing files outside what the plugin
documents, or exposing tokens and other credentials.

The maintainer will acknowledge the report, keep you updated on the fix, and
credit you in the advisory unless you ask not to be named.
